objects.taxonomy_description: Crystal-clear amber or golden-brown broth served in a shallow bowl, exhibiting complete transparency with no visible particulates or cloudiness. The liquid surface shows a slight oily sheen with subtle light refraction. Color ranges from pale gold (chicken) to deep mahogany (beef) depending on the base stock. The soup is presented at serving temperature with visible steam rising. Garnish may include fine julienne vegetables or herbs floating on the surface.
